correctness.rationale: For any even k>=2 and positive fixed b_j, alternating the unit vectors transforms SDP improvement over the all-path-cut into (w||v_k-v_0||^2-Σb_j||v_j-v_{j-1}||²)/4. Weighted Cauchy proves zero gain through w_c=1/S and the unit-sphere collinearity argument makes the critical Gram optimizer unique. For w near w_c, shortest great-circle replacement reduces path minimization to positive small angles, b_j sin(delta_j)=lambda. Expansion Theta=S lambda +T lambda³/6, sin Theta=S lambda-(S³-T)lambda³/6 gives lambda²=6S²(w-w_c)/(S³-T)+O((w-w_c)²). The SDP envelope derivative integrates to 3S⁴(w-w_c)²/[4(S³-T)] plus cubic error. Strict positivity D=S³-T and Jensen T>=S³/k² give the unique uniform minimum and unbounded heterogeneous curvature. Independent high-precision stationary-branch checks agree in 12 weighted small-epsilon instances; they are corroborative, not the proof. Integer cut optimum is constant near w_c since closing edge remains strictly cheapest.
